module.title: Ocean dynamical core: hydrostatic and non-hydrostatic Boussinesq solver
entrypoints: verification/advect_xy, advect_xz, advect_cs, adjustment.128x64x1, adjustment.cs-32x32x1, solid-body.cs-32x32x1 (advection and cubed-sphere)
module.expensive_path: The per-step dynamics in dynamics.F and the implicit free-surface solve: momentum tendency (mom_fluxform/mom_vecinv, calc_mom_rhs), tracer advection with the multidimensional flux-limited schemes in generic_advdiff, the density and pressure integration (find_rho.F, calc_phi_hyd.F), and the preconditioned conjugate-gradient solver cg2d.F (and cg3d.F when non-hydrostatic) that needs one global reduction per iteration and tens of iterations per time step.
module.rationale: model/src plus the momentum packages is the single dynamical core every other configuration runs on; the pure-ocean decks (gyres, channels, convection, advection tests) exercise it without other physics packages, so it is one task with the largest test pool.
excluded: Vertical mixing and eddy parameterisations (kpp, gmredi, ggl90) are mitgcm-mixing-parameterizations
Atmospheric configurations of the same core (hs94, aim, fizhi) are mitgcm-atmosphere
pkg/generic_advdiff is listed as shared infrastructure because every module's tracers use it
hazards: cg2d residual is a global sum; single process with fixed tile order is deterministic, MPI ranks are not
tutorial_barotropic_gyre and tutorial_baroclinic_gyre write 32-bit output by default

approval.human_ref: looks rather nice, lets go? (2026-09-02, all six modules approved; package mitgcm-seaice first)
